import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots to show comprehensive insights
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Survival Rate by Class and Sex
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution by Survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
ax2.hist([df_age[df_age['survived']==0]['age'], df_age[df_age['survived']==1]['age']], 
         bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival Rate by Embarkation Port
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
embark_survival = embark_survival[embark_survival['count'] > 1]
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival.index, embark_survival['mean'], color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#AA96DA'])
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.2f}\n(n={int(embark_survival.iloc[i]["count"])})',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
fare_data = [df[df['class']==cls]['fare'].dropna() for cls in ['First', 'Second', 'Third']]
bp = ax4.boxplot(fare_data, labels=['First', 'Second', 'Third'], patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], ['#FFD93D', '#6BCB77', '#4D96FF']):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (log scale)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_yscale('log')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Family Size vs Survival
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch']
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
family_survival = family_survival[family_survival['count'] >= 5]
ax5.plot(family_survival.index, family_survival['mean'], marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='#E74C3C')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size (Siblings/Spouse + Parents/Children)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Overall Survival Composition
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
colors_pie = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(survival_counts, labels=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_pie)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(11)
ax6.set_title('Overall Survival Rate\n(Total Passengers: {})'.format(len(df)), 
              fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
